title: Chapter 223 System Upgrade Changes
content:
Chapter 223 System Upgrade Changes

Just when Wang Shuo was busy dealing with the reward materials.

The system prompt sounded again.

[The battle for the village order is over, and the system function is adjusted. ]

[1. The teleportation array between towns is open. For specific conditions, please explore by yourself. ]

[2. All refugees can join the town with the Heart of Shelter and become residents of the system town. Refugees without the Heart of Shelter can choose to join the village built by the player. After three days, players without household registration will not be allowed to enter the system town. ]

[3. Except for special building props, all buildings must be built by players of corresponding life professions, and the use of system skills will be further weakened. ]

…

A series of system prompts, each one tells players that the reality of this world is increasing.

The system has been upgraded again, from the 2.0 era to the 3.0 era.

After reading all the information, Wang Shuo took a deep breath.

He fell into deep thought.

At the same time.

Great changes have also taken place in various towns.

Take Nanshanji as an example. The closed lord's mansion in the original core area is opened.

A team of guards walked out, and the leader was wearing a tall hat and a wide belt, with an elegant appearance, looking like a weak scholar.

Soon, the guards posted a notice on the bulletin board, and at the same time, every player in Nanshanji had a system prompt in their mind.

[I am Lin Guanru, the mayor of Nanshanji. Welcome everyone to join Nanshanji. In order to enhance the strength of Nanshanji and select outstanding talents, there are a large number of vacancies in the Lord's Mansion. Welcome all knowledgeable people to challenge. ]

Players can become officials?

Countless players in Nanshanji were shocked and excited.

At the same time, the leaders of the ten major gangs in Nanshanji also received invitations from Mayor Lin Guanru.

Invite them to enter the Lord's Mansion for discussion.

...

The lord in the wild, of course, could not feel this change.

However, Zhang Yu, who was in the Wild Wolf Gang at this time, saw that the gang leader Zhuge Kewei received the invitation letter, and a golden light flashed in his eyes.

When Zhuge Kewei went to the Lord's Mansion to keep the appointment, he quietly sent a message to Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo received the message with a solemn expression.

The huge changes in Nanshanji were beyond his expectation.

According to spy Zhang Yu, a mayor appeared in Nanshanji, and there were also barracks. The level of the guards was generally between 40 and 60, and the number was still unknown.

Moreover, the territory managers who came out of the Lord's Mansion had high IQs and behaved like ordinary people!

Wang Shuo frowned and became a little worried.

The people who appeared in these system towns must not be regarded as system NPCs.

But who are they? What is their purpose?

Wang Shuo was a little worried about this.

"Continue to observe the situation and report at any time!" Wang Shuo replied.

"Chang Gui, do you know what happened?"

Wang Shuo was confused and wanted to get some answers from Chang Gui.

"Lord, I have also felt some changes now, but when I think about it deeply, I feel a splitting headache!"

Wang Shuo sneered, where do you get the head?

After thinking about it, Wang Shuo decided to improve his strength. Now he is no longer the rookie who was scared out of his wits by him!

Besides, there is the constraint of "Thought Stamp", Wang Shuo is also more relieved about Chang Gui.

"Tell me, how many soul crystals do you need to treat your headache."

"Lord, it's generous, 100 will be enough!" Chang Gui directly attached a fist with a thumbs up at the end of the text.

"Then I'll give you 20 first!"

"Lord, you're too stingy!"

"Hmph, if you want more, you have to show your value. Don't you think your role is not reflected at all? Even the military advisor Zou Yuanjie is not as good as you."

"Lord, how can you compare me with that useless military advisor? You wait, when I recover my soul, I will definitely be a proper military advisor."

"Don't just talk!"

After that, Wang Shuo gave Chang Gui 20 soul crystals. He didn't know how much Chang Gui's soul strength could be improved, and whether it would bring him unexpected changes.
